assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease, raising concern for an underlying unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered for further diagnostic evaluation.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I25.10, R00.2.
The CPT code for the cardiac event monitoring study is 93271.
The payer denied this claim with Reason Code CO-97.
Reason Code CO-97 indicates that payment for this service is bundled into another covered service.
The clinical indication for medical necessity is correlating intermittent palpitations with a suspected unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
